Hi! I’m Emalia (sounds like Emma + Lia). As a conservation ecologist and data scientist, my goal is to make a positive impact on natural systems and the communities that depend on them. I have worked on multiple projects aimed at understanding how climate change affects the biodiversity, resilience, and recovery of kelp forests and other aquatic ecosystems. I also specialize in long term monitoring of marine ecosystems, marine protected areas, and ecological restoration.

In my free time I enjoy surfing alongside leopard sharks, backpacking through the Sierras, and drawing the natural spaces I love to explore.
